name: Munakata Natsuo
source:
"Hey, why don't we all take a deep breath and relax?"

A former employee of Aggle, Inc. who transitioned into owning a business. While at Aggle, he worked as an account manager, overseeing Enigma Games' licensing and development with the Alice Engine. Throughout the events of the game, he becomes an ally to [url=/c84005]Arata[/url].

[From [url=https://ideafintl.com/death-request/chara/]Idea Factory[/url]]
